# Hand-owned files in src/core that carry no PROVENANCE block, each classified.
# Read by TestLicensingHandOwnsAreClassified (licensing_test.go). A hand-owned file is an *_impl.cs, or a .cs carrying an
# uncommented [module: GoManualConversion] marker, outside golib, go2cs, go.arrays and go2cs.CpuProfiler. Every one either
# carries a PROVENANCE block (see docs/phase4/DESIGN-provenance-header.md) or has a row here, so a NEW hand-own is red
# until someone has read it against its Go source.
#
# Rows: "<class> <path>", the path relative to src/core with forward slashes, sorted.
#   own      original go2cs code, or glue: bodies for bodyless Go declarations (linkname pushes, assembly funcs) plus
#            original code. Q4 ruled glue is own. Nothing in the file follows a Go function's statements or contract.
#   pending  follows Go, and its header lands elsewhere; the row says where, after " -- ".
# A file that gains a PROVENANCE block leaves this list in the same commit; the guard refuses a file classified both ways.
# The lane that adds a hand-own adds its block or its row in its own seat. P3 reads every change to this list at seat
# reads, as it reads the headers: a new "own" row is a claim that nothing in the file follows Go.
#
# Derivation: the 94 files of the 2026-11-26 sweep left unheaded (docs/phase4/DATA-go-attribution-scout-2026-11-26.md,
# Step 2 results and P3's read folded: 92 own or glue, 1 bodies plus original code, 1 skipped).
